[EN] You helped the Consos Clan keep the temple clean.
[ES] Ayudaste al Consos Clan a mantener el templo limpio.

[EN] The Consos Clan would be grateful if you could help us keep the temple clean.

Please use the teleportal to enter the temple underground, and speak with Davor."I'm happy to help."
[ES] El Consos Clan estaría agradecido si pudieras ayudarnos a mantener el templo limpio.

Por favor, usa el teleportal para entrar a los subterráneos del templo y habla con Davor."I'm happy to help."

[EN] It is good to see you, .

The sloths are being particularly bothersome. I would be very grateful if you could clean up some of the messes they have made in the temple underground.

If they offer too much resistance, please feel free to make use of the PEST-B-GON 8000 automaton."I suppose someone has to do it..."
[ES] Es bueno verte, .

Los perezosos están siendo particularmente molestos. Estaría muy agradecido si pudieras limpiar algunos de los desastres que han hecho en los subterráneos del templo.

Si ofrecen demasiada resistencia, por favor siéntete libre de usar el autómata PEST-B-GON 8000."I suppose someone has to do it..."
